name: How To Consecrate Oil
overview: The consecration of oil in Scripture is depicted as a sacred act involving careful preparation and dedication to God's purposes. Exodus 30:25 instructs making a holy anointing oil with precise craftsmanship, emphasizing its sanctity. Jacob's act of pouring oil as a drink offering upon a stone pillar (Genesis 35:14) illustrates the oil's role in worship and covenant remembrance. While Exodus 15:26 highlights God's promise of healing to those who obey Him, it underscores the holiness required in all acts of devotion, including the use of consecrated oil.
